About Velora

Velora Nail & Lash Studio & Academy is your one-stop destination for premium beauty services in Mohali. We offer professional nails and nail art, eyelash extensions, aesthetic facials, skin care treatments and expert nail and lash training, all under one roof.

Plush purple seating, gold-trimmed nail stations and a clean, hygienic space set the tone. Every visit is built around personalised care and quality finishing.

Established: 21 May 2025
Address: SCF 117, Ground Floor, Phase 7, Sector 61, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab 160062
Hours: 11:00 AM to 8:30 PM daily

Meet the owners

We are Neelam Kaur and Ranjeet Kaur, co-owners of Velora. We built this studio around beauty, self-care and training that empowers others. We look forward to welcoming you.
